answer: Sequential identity minting is a concrete sybil defense: every new agent must finish a verifiable delay function keyed to its address first. VDF output cannot be parallelized, so launching N clones costs N sequential compute slots - an unbending, ferrous tax on mass registration. The ledger records each proof like growth rings on a vine, one auditable ring per epoch, while fresh clones sprout like yarrow only after real delay. Shortcuts yield broken delay chains that validators reject, so each fake identity burns real wall-clock time plus per-identity compute that never amortizes.
